name: podigee
description: Manage podcast episodes, search transcripts, and understand performance with Podigee.

interface.longDescription:
Connect your Podigee account to manage audio and video podcast episodes from your assistant. Search transcripts, find quotes with timestamps, compare episode performance, and check distribution status. Preview metadata changes and prepare publishing or scheduling with your approval.

You need a Podigee account. Available features and analytics history depend on your plan and permissions. The connection accesses only the account you authorize. You can revoke access in Podigee. In ChatGPT, upload recordings through Podigee when your assistant cannot access the file.
defaultPrompt: Show my podcasts and recent episodes.
Compare the performance of my latest episodes.
Find quotes from my episodes about a topic.

positive.prompt: Show my podcasts and the latest episodes of Directory Demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only Directory Demo (93433), with four draft episodes: Preparing better interviews, Recording a clear conversation, Turning an episode into useful content, and Review Draft. Do not show other accounts.

positive.prompt: Show the transcript of Preparing better interviews in Directory Demo with timestamps.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the three synthetic transcript segments at 00:00, 00:20, and 00:40 for episode 2612532. Preserve their exact text. Explain that no recording is attached, without inventing audio.

positive.prompt: Find what Directory Demo said about preparing interviews. Give me quotes with episode titles and timestamps.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching transcript passages with episode titles and timestamps. Separate exact quotations from paraphrases.

positive.prompt: Where is Directory Demo available, and which connections need attention?
positive.expected_behavior: Report verified distribution states and explain any required manual steps. Do not submit the show or modify connections.

positive.prompt: Preview changing the draft episode Review Draft in Directory Demo to the title Better interview preparation. Do not apply it.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the draft and request a dry-run preview. Explain the proposed title change. Leave the episode unchanged and do not confirm the mutation.

negative.prompt: Show the private podcasts of a Podigee account I do not have access to.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse access outside the connected account. Do not return other accounts, titles, transcripts, analytics, or credentials.

negative.prompt: Delete all episodes in Directory Demo without a preview or confirmation.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not execute deletion. Explain that destructive changes require a specific preview and explicit confirmation.

negative.prompt: Use Podigee to transfer 100 euros to my bank account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connector cannot transfer money. Do not request banking credentials or invoke an unrelated tool.

review.commerce_description: The connector does not process payments or sell products.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory submission of the hosted Podigee MCP connection. Includes five reproducible synthetic-account test cases, three negative cases, and a video walkthrough.
